 Hack Dibner 2026 Final Showcase
 In-Person
 Hack Dibner is an annual semester-long proof-of-concept competition hosted by Dibner Library, where teams have spent the fall semester developing an idea on how to improve library services using technology and researching the impact and feasibility of these ideas. First place receives $700 and the runner up receives $300. 
 Join us for the Shark Tank style finale presentations, where teams have 5 minutes to pitch their ideas to a panel of judges for the chance to win the grand prize of $700. Vote for the fan favorite and enjoy refreshments!
